# Psalm 140 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** To-the-choirmaster. A-psalm of-David. Deliver-me O-YHWH from-man evil; from-man-of violence preserve-me,

**2** Who devise evil in-the-heart; every day they-stir-up wars.

**3** They-sharpen their-tongue like-a-serpent; venom-of a-viper under their-lips. Selah.

**4** Keep-me O-YHWH from-hands-of the-wicked; from-man-of violence preserve-me, who have-planned to-trip my-steps.

**5** Have-hidden the-proud a-trap for-me, and-cords they-have-spread a-net; by-side-of the-path snares they-have-set for-me. Selah.

**6** I-have-said to-YHWH, 'My-God you-are'; give-ear O-YHWH to-voice-of my-supplications.

**7** O-YHWH Lord strength-of my-salvation, you-have-covered my-head in-day-of battle.

**8** Do-not grant O-YHWH desires-of the-wicked; his-plan do-not promote. Selah.

**9** The-head-of those-surrounding-me, the-mischief-of their-lips let-cover-them.

**10** Let-be-dropped upon-them coals; in-fire let-him-cast-them, in-pits not let-them-rise.

**11** A-man-of tongue not let-be-established in-the-land; a-man-of violence — evil let-it-hunt-him thrust-upon-thrust.

**12** I-know that will-do YHWH the-cause-of the-afflicted, the-justice-of the-needy.

**13** Surely the-righteous will-give-thanks to-your-name; will-dwell the-upright before-your-face.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **140:3**: 'Venom-of a-viper under their-lips' — quoted by Paul in Romans 3:13 as part of the universal indictment of human sinfulness.

— EMET
